confidence_notes: FX is from the RBA overview page: AUD/USD 0.6720 at 4pm on 18 Nov 2026. I ran one food and drink search, which found crowdsourced cost-of-living sites and blogs of mixed dates. Beer is about €3.5-4.5 and a cappuccino about €2.7-3.5. Inexpensive and mid-range meal figures come from taverna price ranges. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price (cocktail about 2.2x beer, glass of wine about 1.2x beer) because no reliable bar prices were found. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, with no listings checked. They are uncertain because Chania prices swing sharply with the season, and July is peak. The reference date is July 2026, but the FX observation is the latest available at generation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Chania's own price levels, cross-checked against other Greek island tourist towns such as Rhodes and Heraklion, with peak-season July accommodation pricing.
